smallest_next_experiment.common_clock_minimal_patch_NOT_IMPLEMENT: Reuse existing4915/5466 FeedbackHub/Client framing, bounded dependency/abort and per-replica packet sequence, but host both independent hubs on one existing CPU coordinator process. Thin publish receipt callback stamps both streams using that single perf_counter; no new engine/profiler and no networkthread GPU calls. Both isolated and concurrent phases use the same collector topology. Retain original tail-local metrics separately.
smallest_next_experiment.timing_contract: Common collector arrival timestamps define one declared service-observer clock (includes feedback transport; not exact tailready/client time). Global decode anchor=max(first decision arrival across32requests), end=max(last decision arrival); numerator counts useful nonEOS decisions strictly after common anchor. Throughput=that numerator/(end-anchor), divide32allservicecards; report per-request local first-to-last speed/TTFT/ITL alongside collector metrics. Do not add isolated TPS or use per-replica relative clocks as sharedabsolute times. Reuse saved pertokenIDs/timestamps, no extra per-token synchronization.
smallest_next_experiment.quality_stop: Any native/finite/owner/counter/IDs/EOS failure stops adoption and restores existing policies. Missing replica/commonclock makes aggregate NOT_QUALIFIED. No meaningful concurrent percard benefit beyond isolated drift -> stop expansion; no batch/node grid.
smallest_next_experiment.ordinary_measurement: No TLS/profile/rowcapture; existing selected raw snapshots for CPUargmax remain bounded and identical between phases. Sole question is concurrent service replication, not new kernel math.

A sequential PP4 load is another~15min floor/actualUNKNOWN plus fresh matched fixture/quality. Do not pay this until currentPP4 guard/ABI adaptation has a specific executable package.

decision: First qualify dual current16replica efficiency. HistoricalPP4 is a clearly labeled reference. A fair pureparallelism comparison is currently NOT_RUN/NOT_READY because current native explicitlyPP2-only. More replicas can raise total throughput at fixed percard efficiency; they do not mathematically raise a single user beyond the16card instance path.
